issue.title: Decide and apply a real type or home for the 13 root *_ref hub notes typed [[ref]]

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (note #10, F1 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent. Bryan's decision is needed first.

13 root-level hub notes in the vault carry `type: "[[ref]]"` but are topic hubs, not library references: asciidoc_ref, alfred_ref, obsidian_ref, dev_ref, nvim_ref, mcp_ref, zorg_ref, gemini_cli_ref, ai_ref, keyboard_maestro_ref, sase_ref, work_ref, org_mode_ref (another 16 root *_ref.md hubs already use other types). Because the type lies, bob props has to scope NoteKind::Reference by ref_library coverage (bob-cli-qp.1), and the Ref Card host excludes these notes by path. Bryan decides one of these options:
(a) retype them to an existing hub-ish type, for example the type the other 16 root *_ref hubs use;

(c) move them under a hub folder; or
(d) leave them as they are.
After the decision, apply it through a previewed, reviewed vault edit (no blind bulk write). Confirm that bob ref list, the Reading Board, bob props, and the Ref Card host all still classify them correctly, and update any docs that name the hub-note exception (docs/props.md coverage scope, glossary:ref-card "Root *_ref hub notes get no card").

fields.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (note #10, F1 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent. Bryan's decision is needed first.

13 root-level hub notes in the vault carry `type: "[[ref]]"` but are topic hubs, not library references: asciidoc_ref, alfred_ref, obsidian_ref, dev_ref, nvim_ref, mcp_ref, zorg_ref, gemini_cli_ref, ai_ref, keyboard_maestro_ref, sase_ref, work_ref, org_mode_ref (the other 16 root *_ref.md hubs carry no `type:` at all). Because the type lies, bob props has to scope NoteKind::Reference by ref_library coverage (bob-cli-qp.1), and the Ref Card host excludes these notes by path. They get no Ref Card and no Property Card of their own.

Bryan decides one of these options:
(a) drop the type so they match the other 16 untyped root *_ref hubs;
(b) give them their own `[[ref_hub]]`-style type, which a later card could claim;
(c) move them under a hub folder; or
(d) leave them as they are.
After the decision, apply it through a previewed, reviewed vault edit (no blind bulk write). Confirm that bob ref list, the Reading Board, bob props, and the Ref Card host all still classify them correctly, and update any docs that name the hub-note exception (docs/props.md coverage scope, glossary:ref-card "Root *_ref hub notes get no card").

The Ref Cards plan put retyping or re-homing the root *_ref hubs explicitly out of scope ("Bryan's call"), and writing to existing vault notes was also out of scope. The epic only made every surface ignore them safely.
